open_points.subject: grant_project
open_points.text: grant_project: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST check in stage order and answer the first failing stage with every failure of it, ordered by kind in the order the operation's errors list the kinds and within one kind by path: at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_EXISTENCE constant names the NOT_FOUND member of = models.RefusalCode with the UNKNOWN_SESSION member of = models.RefusalKind, its path naming the session_id input, when load_agent_session finds no session and the UNKNOWN_PROJECT member, its path naming the project_id input, when validation says the project does not exist; at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_VERSION constant names the STALE member with the STALE_ACCESS_VERSION member, its path naming the stated_access_version input, when _access_version_stale answers true; at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_LIFECYCLE constant names the REFUSED member with the ARCHIVED member, its path naming the project_id input, when validation says the project exists and is not active, a project already granted or active included.
open_points.other_text: grant_project: [BEHAVIOR] MUST add project_id to the granted set when it is not there and, when make_active is true, make it the active project, making the access version, once, one more than the one before through one replace_agent_session for the whole change and answering AccessChanged with project_joined telling whether it joined the set and changed true; when the project is already in the set and nothing else changes it MUST write nothing, leave the version and answer changed false.
open_points.question: Must an already-granted archived project be refused with ARCHIVED, or answered with AccessChanged and changed false; alternatively, must the no-change rule be restricted explicitly to an active project?

open_points.subject: list_sessions
open_points.text: list_sessions: [DETERMINISM_OR_ORDERING] MUST answer one SessionListItem for every session list_agent_session_rows gives, in the order it gives them without sorting again, each with the session's registration instant, the access _session_access gives and the text of its pending request, None when no request is pending.
open_points.other_text: list_sessions: [TEST_EVIDENCE] A test MUST show that sessions are listed by registration instant, earliest first, and two sessions registered at the same instant by session identity compared by Unicode code point, every list answering each session once in one total order.
open_points.question: Must list_sessions preserve the unspecified order returned by list_agent_session_rows without sorting, or must it establish the stated registration-time and session-identity order?

open_points.subject: set_active_project
open_points.text: set_active_project: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST check in stage order and answer the first failing stage with every failure of it, ordered by kind in the order the operation's errors list the kinds and within one kind by path: at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_EXISTENCE constant names the NOT_FOUND member of = models.RefusalCode with the UNKNOWN_SESSION member of = models.RefusalKind, its path naming the session_id input, when load_agent_session finds no session; at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_VERSION constant names the STALE member with the STALE_ACCESS_VERSION member, its path naming the stated_access_version input, when _access_version_stale answers true; at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_LIFECYCLE constant names, for a given project_id, the REFUSED member with the NOT_GRANTED member when it is not in the granted set and the ARCHIVED member when project_archived is true, each its path naming the project_id input, the project already active included.
open_points.other_text: set_active_project: [BEHAVIOR] MUST make project_id the active project, or clear the active project when project_id is None, leaving the granted set as it is, so clearing revokes nothing; a change MUST make the access version, once, one more than the one before through replace_agent_session and answer AccessChanged with changed true, and a project already active or a clearing of a clear one MUST write nothing and answer changed false; project_joined MUST be false.
open_points.question: Must an already-active archived project be refused with ARCHIVED, or answered with changed false; alternatively, must the no-op rule be restricted explicitly to a non-archived project?
